title: Replication-weighted recall: boost memories confirmed by independent sessions
mechanism: Count confirmations from distinct source sessions per memory (store.get_confirmations plus provenance source triplets), expose it as a scoring factor inside the bounded envelope so a learning re-observed in 2+ independent sessions outranks a single-session conclusion of equal similarity; single-run conclusions keep the default weight

expected_gain.rationale: Buehler's three repeated Fable runs on one research brief reached model-dependent conclusions; single-session automatic learnings carry the same variance, and confirmations already exist in the store but do not reach ranking

cost.scope: chitta-field/src/scoring/factors.rs, chitta-field/src/scoring/config.rs, chitta-field/src/store.rs (confirmation count on MemoryState)

evidence.claim: three autonomous runs from identical prompts produced model-dependent conclusions, including different responses to weakened interfaces
technologies accumulate through executable inheritance and persistent agent-artifact networks; reuse across agents, not single invention, marks durable technology
